snapshot.what_it_does: ICICI Bank Limited is a banking company whose fiscal 2026 annual report describes a bank offering retail banking, business banking, corporate banking and treasury services through branches, digital platforms (iMobile, InstaBIZ, DigiEase, Retail Net Banking) and a network of 7,511 business centres. Through subsidiaries and associates it also has life insurance, general insurance, securities, home finance, asset management and other financial services businesses, consolidated in its group results.

items.statement: NIMs expected to remain more or less range bound, reflecting repricing of external benchmarks and competition, offset by retail term repricing
items.speaker: Sandeep Batra
items.quote: Looking ahead, we do expect NIMs to remain more or less range bound, reflecting the repricing of the external benchmarks on loans and investments

items.statement: No specific loan growth targets; focus on maximizing PBT in a risk-calibrated fashion
items.speaker: Sandeep Batra
items.quote: we do not give any specific targets of what we are going to be growing. Our focus is to maximize PBT in a risk calibrated fashion

items.statement: Bank will work to bring the agriculture PSL portfolio into conformity with regulatory expectations and minimise provisioning impact; provisions may be written back if cured
items.speaker: Sandeep Batra
items.quote: we will work towards repayment and renewal of these loans to make them in conformity with PSL classifications, and our endeavour... is to minimise the impact

items.statement: ECL provisioning will be complied with when regulations come into place; currently an internal assessment
items.speaker: Sandeep Batra
items.quote: ECL is still an internal assessment. Whenever the regulations come into place, we will be compliant with that.

items.statement: Once the impact of repo rate cuts settles in, profit growth should return to better levels
items.speaker: Sandeep Batra

items.statement: No major incremental provisions expected on the agri-PSL book going forward; additional provisions continue until loans are repaid or renewed in conformity with PSL guidelines

items.statement: Bank will continue to meet PSL requirements and pursue rural lending opportunities

items.statement: Current capital adequacy is sufficient to support further loan growth; no need to raise capital

items.statement: Bank will continue to invest in ICICI Home Finance and support it with capital as needed

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Credibility is high: near-term promises on NIM stability, profit recovery, credit costs and capital were met, with the Q1 FY27 NIM dip occurring under the FCNR caveat management itself flagged. The main open item is the agri-PSL provision write-back, which slipped from 'next few months' to 'coming quarter or next' and remains pending.

bull.point: Loan momentum strong: Q2 FY27 advances +30% YoY and +12.3% QoQ (+24% ex-FCNR), building on FY26 loan growth of 15.8% to Rs 15,538.93 billion.
Profit accelerating: Q2 FY27 PAT +22.3% YoY to Rs 16,333 crore, NII +15.9%, fee income +20.1% to Rs 7,795 crore after +23.5% in Q1.
Guidance credibility rated high: promises on NIM stability, profit recovery, 32bps credit cost and no capital raise were all delivered.

bear.point: NIM compressed to 4.18% in Q2 FY27 from 4.36% in Q1 on FCNR deployment; recovery is only a Q3 FY27 promise, not yet delivered.
Agri-PSL provision write-back slipped from 'next few months' to 'coming quarter or next', still pending RBI discussion — the main open guidance item.
Capital adequacy drifting down: 17.18% in FY26 to 16.84% (Jun-26) and 16.68% (Sep-26); earnings showed volatility with PAT -2.7% YoY in Dec-25 quarter.

watch: Q3 FY27 NIM print: management promised an uptick once the full FCNR impact is reflected — test whether 4.18% was the trough.
Agri-PSL provision write-back landing in Q3/Q4 FY27 per the revised timeline, contingent on the RBI discussion.
Durability of ex-FCNR loan growth (+24% YoY vs +30% headline) and whether CAR stabilises after sliding to 16.68%.
